short: Hot Player activation — unlock the Hot Player IPTV app on your device (Firestick, Android & Smart TV). One-time activation, load any playlist, no monthly app fee.
long:
Hot Player is a popular IPTV player app, and this is its official device activation. Activate the app on your device once and it's ready to use — just add your own IPTV playlist (M3U or Xtream Codes login from your provider) and start watching. It's a clean, ad-light player with a tidy interface, EPG support, favourites and multi-playlist support.

Activation works on Amazon Firestick & Fire TV, Android phones, TV boxes and Android TV, and other supported devices. You provide your device's MAC or device key at checkout and we activate it for you. Note: Hot Player is the player app only — you'll still need an IPTV subscription or playlist to watch. Choose the plan that suits you from the options on this page.

faqs.q: What exactly am I buying — a subscription or the player?
faqs.a: This is the Hot Player app activation, not an IPTV subscription. It unlocks the player on your device so you can load your own IPTV playlist (M3U or Xtream Codes). You'll still need an IPTV subscription to watch — we sell those too.
Hot Player activation works on Amazon Firestick & Fire TV, Android phones, TV boxes and Android TV, and other supported devices. Just share your device's MAC or key at checkout.
Install the Hot Player app, send us the MAC address or device key it shows, and we activate it for you. Then add your playlist and you're ready to watch.

faqs.q: How long does the activation last?
faqs.a: The activation length and its price are shown on this page — pick the option that suits you.

faqs.q: How fast is activation after I pay?
faqs.a: Activation is done shortly after your payment is confirmed, so you can usually start watching within minutes.
